description: Retrieve details of a single Zendesk attachment by ID, including available file metadata, URLs, and thumbnails.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for getting a single Zendesk attachment by ID.

attachment_id.description: The numeric ID of the attachment to retrieve. You can find attachment IDs in ticket comments or via the attachments list endpoint.
attachment_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the attachment you want to view. You can find this ID from ticket comment attachments or from the attachment list.
attachment_id.title: Attachment Id

inputSchema.title: GetAttachmentRequest

name: get_attachment

Attachment.description: Attachment object representing a file in Zendesk.

content_url.description: URL to access the attachment file content
content_url.title: Content Url

deleted.description: Whether the attachment has been soft-deleted
deleted.title: Deleted

height.description: Image height in pixels; null for non-image files
height.title: Height

inline.description: Whether the attachment is displayed inline in the article body (true) or as a downloadable file (false)
inline.title: Inline

malware_access_override.description: If true, allows access to attachments flagged as malware
malware_access_override.title: Malware Access Override

malware_scan_result.description: Malware scan result: malware_found, malware_not_found, pending, or skipped
malware_scan_result.title: Malware Scan Result

mapped_content_url.description: URL the attachment has been mapped to
mapped_content_url.title: Mapped Content Url

thumbnails.description: Array of thumbnail attachments for images
thumbnails.title: Thumbnails

url.description: URL to access the attachment details
url.title: Url

width.description: Image width in pixels; null for non-image files
width.title: Width
